title: Large Data Volumes: Eliminating Reporting Timeouts Across 18M Rows

steps.prompt: A custom object Transaction__c contains 18 million records. Standard reports filtering on Region__c and Fiscal_Quarter__c while sorting by CreatedDate are timing out. How should the architect optimize query performance?

options.label: Request a Skinny Table from Salesforce Support containing the filtered and sorted fields
options.rationale: Skinny tables combine standard and custom fields into a flat, unjoined database table, eliminating table join overhead for LDV reporting and queries.

options.label: Create custom indexes on Region__c and Fiscal_Quarter__c and sort by standard CreatedDate
options.distractorAntipattern: Independent single-column b-tree indexes cannot eliminate composite sort overhead on standard CreatedDate across 18M rows.
options.rationale: Independent single-column indexes force the query optimizer to perform index union/merges and an expensive in-memory sort on CreatedDate across millions of rows, still timing out standard reports.

options.label: Create a deterministic formula field combining Region and Quarter with a custom index
options.distractorAntipattern: A custom index on a concatenated formula does not optimize composite sorting on standard CreatedDate during report aggregation.
options.rationale: While deterministic formula fields can be indexed, filtering on concatenated text does not eliminate the full table sort on standard CreatedDate for 18 million records.
